messages:
ashok: Heads up — canary of gateway sampling is causing invoice preview deltas. Not huge but consistent +0.3% token delta.
maria: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/ops/preview-delta :eyes: looks correlated with edge-canary-5401
ashok: quick reproducer: sampled traffic that hits LB has X-Route-Tag stripped by proxy. We intentionally trim headers for safety. Example request we captured before proxy:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer ***
X-Route-Tag: tenant=acme-ua
X-Request-Id: 123
```
...after proxy the header is gone:
```
X-Route-Tag: (missing)
```
maria: missing tag => attribution falls to fallback route (default_plan) for metering. That maps to different unit pricing -> explains the +0.3% cost shift.
jamie: ugh, so even though the same model/seqs, routing attr is different, preview shows credit drift. Did we see this only for sampled canary traffic?
ashok: yes mostly in canary shards 3 & 7. Looks like the new sampling path uses an older proxy config that trims headers.
leo: options: 1) stop trimming that header for internal traffic, 2) add a signed header on ingress we can trust, 3) infer route in metering from host/path. 3 is flaky.
maria: we shouldn't blindly trust customer headers. Need a verification/signing step. Proposed: edge-proxy keeps stripping untrusted X-* from public traffic, but for internal clients (canaries, partners) we allow X-Route-Tag and add x-signed-route:sha256(...) so metering can trust it.
jamie: also suggest event schema change so metering records attribution_reason: ["signed","inferred","fallback"] and an inferred_vs_signed boolean. That will help split invoice previews.
billing-bot: invoice-preview job ran at 02:00 UTC and included canary window 02:00–02:15. FYI.
sre-bot: deploy 5401/edge-proxy canary started at 6078898000, rollout paused on flags.
leo: action items: ashok — create allowlist PR for edge-proxy header passthrough + signing. jamie — add attribution_reason and inferred_vs_signed to metering event schema and backfill mapping in preview service. maria — add dashboard card comparing signed vs inferred attribution counts and a preview-delta heatmap.
ashok: I'll open the PR and include tests for header normalization and signing. Will tag @eng-releases once green. :thumbsup:
maria: can product get an alert if preview delta > 0.5%? want to be able to pause canaries automatically.
jamie: yes I'll add a Prom rule and Console alert (alert: invoice_preview_delta > 0.5% over 15m).
ashok: rough ETA: PR today, schema change early tomorrow, dashboard mid-week. Keep canary paused until header fix validated.
maria: thanks — please post updates here so SRE and Billing teams can track.
leo: tagging billing ops to review reconciliation steps: @billing-ops
ashok: noted. I'll also add a one-off job to re-run preview for affected window after fix to sanity-check numbers.
maria: great.
